description: Ensure full feature parity between PowerShell and Bash implementations of ralph scripts. Create missing bash equivalents (ralph-once.sh, ralph-parallel.sh), add global registry functions, and audit existing implementations for consistency.

userStories.title: Create ralph-once.sh Bash Script
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/ralph/ralph-once.sh with same functionality as ralph-once.ps1
Script sources ralph-utils.sh for shared utilities
Shows banner and current PRD status on startup
Runs single Claude Code iteration with prompt.md
Captures and displays Claude Code output
Checks for completion signal <promise>COMPLETE</promise>
Reports progress difference before/after iteration
Script is executable (chmod +x)
Manual test: ./ralph-once.sh executes single iteration successfully
userStories.notes: Single iteration runner for testing and manual control. No loop, no archive.

userStories.title: Create ralph-parallel.sh Bash Script
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/ralph/ralph-parallel.sh with same functionality as ralph-parallel.ps1
Supports commands: start, stop, kill, status, dashboard, help
Start command accepts -c COUNT and -m MAX_ITERATIONS options
Uses background processes (&) for parallel execution
Stores job PIDs in instances/running-jobs.json
Stop command sends SIGTERM to running processes
Kill command sends SIGKILL to running processes
Status command shows running instances, locks, and PRD progress
Dashboard command launches ralph-dashboard.sh
Respects RALPH_MAX_INSTANCES environment variable (default: 8)
Script is executable
Manual test: ./ralph-parallel.sh start -c 2 launches 2 instances
userStories.notes: Parallel instance launcher using bash background jobs. CPU cores / 2 as default count.

userStories.title: Add Global Registry Functions to ralph-utils.sh
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_ralph_global_link_name() function to ralph-utils.sh
Add register_ralph_global_instance() function that creates symlink
Add unregister_ralph_global_instance() function that removes symlink
Functions create/remove symlinks in ~/.ralph/global/instances/
Link name format: {project-name}-{instance-id}
Functions respect RALPH_GLOBAL_DISABLE=1 environment variable
ralph.sh calls register on startup in init_instance()
ralph.sh calls unregister in cleanup_on_exit()
Manual test: run ralph and verify symlink appears in ~/.ralph/global/instances/
userStories.notes: GM-004 bash implementation. Symlinks allow global dashboard to monitor across projects.

acceptanceCriteria: Compare ralph-cleanup.ps1 and ralph-cleanup.sh line-by-line
Verify same CLI options: -d/--dead, -o/--old, -a/--all, --dry-run/-WhatIf
Verify same TTL handling (RALPH_CLEANUP_TTL env var, default 7 days)
